outcome_definition: Employment-normalized documented Fortune corporate-anchor rate per 100,000 2022 QCEW jobs, empirically shrunk toward the national rate using the median cohort workforce. The global-HQ component is complete; the regional/divisional component is documented public evidence, not a complete office census. Metro employment is deliberately excluded from the explanatory feature set.
